infobox.usage: Unlocks the technical storeroom in the command part of the underground bunker system on Reserve.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: RB-PKPTS key (RB-PKPTS) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A Federal State Reserve Agency base bunker technical storeroom key. Now all that remains is to find this storeroom.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Used in the story chapter The Ticket

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the technical storeroom in the command part of the underground bunker system on Reserve.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Loose loot (Valuables, Electronics, Provisions)
- Intelligence folder spawn on the desk
